_note: Golden reel 2 of 3: the 'Second Tier' story, rebuilt from a plan. The person is drawn as an inspired-by illustration: era, clothes and setting, never a copy of a real face (safety rule 6).

lead.topic: An actor who began as a ₹100 junior artist returns to the same hall as the lead
sources: actor's own account in interviews (to be linked before any posting)

images.prompt: Late 1990s Tamil film shoot inside a grand old theatre. Seen from behind a man's shoulder, his arm pointing up a red-carpeted staircase with brass railings. A thin young man in his twenties with curly hair and a moustache, grey half-sleeve shirt, turns back on the stairs looking small and unsure. Warm tungsten film lights above

Late 1990s, upper balcony of an old Tamil cinema hall with worn red seats. A thin young man in his twenties with curly hair and a moustache, grey shirt, sits among a crowd of extras, a banana leaf with rice and lemon rice on his lap, a single hundred rupee note in his hand, looking toward the stage with hope. Warm light from below

View from the high second-tier balcony of an old theatre during a 1990s film shoot. A thin young man with curly hair, grey shirt, seen from behind, leaning on the brass balcony rail, looking far down at a brightly lit stage where a film crew, a big cine camera on a dolly and dancers are working. He is tiny and far from the lights

Close view of a thin young man in his twenties with curly hair and a moustache, grey shirt, slumped in a red theatre seat in the dark upper balcony, eyes lowered, jaw tight, holding back hurt. Rows of other extras blurred behind him. Dim warm light on one side of his face

Years later. A man in a long dark coat seen from behind, walking down the centre aisle of the same grand old theatre toward a glowing stage, rows of empty red seats on both sides, golden stage lights and haze, balconies above

A bearded man in his forties dressed as a Mughal emperor for a stage drama, jewelled turban, pearl necklaces, embroidered maroon robe, standing proud on a theatre stage and looking up at the far balcony. Low angle from the stage floor, golden spotlights and haze behind him, a film camera to one side

screens.headline: BACK TO HIS SEAT.
screens.tamil: ஒரு துணை நடிகரை மீண்டும் அவர் இருக்கைக்கு அனுப்பினார்கள்.

screens.headline: IN THE *SHOT*.
screens.tamil: ஒரே ஒரு ஷாட்டில் தெரிய வேண்டும். அவ்வளவுதான்.

screens.headline: HOPING.
screens.tamil: திரையில் தெரிய வேண்டும் என்று கீழே இறங்கினார்.

screens.headline: "I FELT SMALL."
screens.tamil: இன்னொரு நடிகர் அவரை மேலே திருப்பி அனுப்பினார்.

screens.headline: TO THE SAME HALL.
screens.tamil: அவரது இருபத்தைந்தாவது படம் அதே அரங்கிற்கு அழைத்து வந்தது.

screens.headline: FACED THE *STAGE*.
screens.tamil: இந்த முறை கேமரா மேடையை நோக்கி இருந்தது.

screens.headline: PLAYING AN EMPEROR.
screens.tamil: நூறு ரூபாய்க்கு வந்த அதே இளைஞர், இப்போது மேடையில் பேரரசர்.

screens.headline: VIJAY SETHUPATHI.
screens.tamil: அந்த துணை நடிகர் வேறு யாருமில்லை. விஜய் சேதுபதி.

screens.headline: THE SECOND TIER?
screens.tamil: இன்னும் மேல் வரிசையில் காத்திருக்கும் நண்பருக்கு அனுப்புங்க.

caption.text:
₹100-kku vandha junior artist. Adhe hall-la hero.
Oru Tamil nadigar-oda unmai kadhai: second tier-la irundhu stage varaikkum.
Unga life-la 'second tier' moment edhu?
Innum kaathirukkura friend-ku anuppunga.
caption.first_comment: Kadaisi varaikkum yaaru nu guess panningala?
